claims_for_research.claim: Pydantic v2 model_copy(update=...) does not validate supplied update values.
Pydantic 2.13.5 JsonValue uses list, dict, string, boolean, integer, float and null alternatives, without a tuple alternative.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction; BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts one immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY.
SQLite trigger RAISE(ABORT, message) terminates the triggering statement and returns SQLITE_CONSTRAINT with the supplied message.
Python 3.12 hashlib includes sha256 and hexadecimal output through hexdigest.
RFC 8785 sorts object property names by UTF-16 code units and requires UTF-8 output encoding.
OSXExperts publishes the executable checksum values attributed to its checksum page; current download correspondence is explicitly unverified.
FFprobe decoded timestamps and time bases support variable-rate frame addressing independently of rounded average FPS.
FFmpeg -noautorotate disables automatic rotation, explicit mapping selects the specified stream, and select's n is the zero-based filter-input frame number.
FFmpeg can fall back from a requested pixel format.
CamWorldQA was published on 2026-08-19 and evaluates camera-controlled generated video using 720 videos and an 18-person randomized subjective study.
BeyondMasks was published on 2026-08-20 and evaluates object removal against intended effects including shadows and reflections.

Certified Selective Automation of LLM Agent Evaluation was published on 2026-09-28, studies correlated samples and task-level calibration, and supplies an approximate bootstrap certificate without a finite-sample theorem.
The 2026-09-20 EPUB Annotations 1.0 W3C Working Draft profiles annotation identities, creators, timestamps, targets and selectors.
Pydantic 2.14.0, dated 2026-10-08, preserves unvalidated updates while avoiding deep copies of replaced fields and retains the seven JsonValue alternatives.
SQLite 3.51.3, dated 2026-03-13, fixes a WAL-reset corruption bug.
Python 3.14 documentation recommends positional initial-data arguments for hashlib compatibility and deprecates the string keyword spelling.
C2PA 2.4, dated April 2026, adds repository receipts attesting manifest ingestion.
